# Vantage Rock Financial

> Fractional CFO firm delivering AI-enabled finance, FP&A, and AI implementation for founder-led and sponsor-backed companies from $1M in revenue. The single public offer is a 30-minute Finance Systems Review — a fit-check. We don't diagnose on the call.

Vantage Rock Financial provides fractional CFO leadership, FP&A, and AI implementation for the finance function. Most finance teams spend the bulk of their time producing numbers and only a fraction of it interpreting them. Vantage Rock exists to change that ratio: AI compresses the mechanical work — the close, the reconciliation, the assembly of the report — so the output arrives while it can still influence a decision.

The AI is not the product. It is how the work gets delivered. A human sits between the systems and the decisions.

## Locked facts

- The only public offer is a 30-minute Finance Systems Review. It is a fit-check, not a sales call. We don't diagnose on the call and you don't leave with a plan. Fees are scoped after fit; there are no list prices, because scope moves with entity count, systems, and how much of the function needs rebuilding rather than running.
- Three services, describing one engagement from three angles: Fractional CFO Services; AI-Enabled Finance; AI-Native Financial Leadership.
- Founder: Stavros Christias, Founder & Fractional CFO. Over a decade across healthcare, technology and SaaS, startups, and private-equity-backed businesses. You talk to the operator — there is no sales team and no account manager.
- Who it is for: founder-led and sponsor-backed companies from $1M in revenue, typically alongside an existing bookkeeper or controller. Strongest in healthcare, professional services, technology and SaaS, and multi-entity groups.
- What Vantage Rock does not do: tax, audit, and bookkeeping. Existing CPAs and bookkeepers stay in place; the fractional CFO works above that layer.
- Agents we've built, five of them, run the repeating finance work: Month-End Close Agent, Cashflow Agent, Expense Agent, Flux Analysis Agent, Daily Brief Agent. Not five products — five pieces of one job.
- Three control rules never move: every figure traces to a source record; nothing posts to the ledger unreviewed; a person signs anything that leaves the building.
- Documented result, one anonymized healthcare and wellness engagement: month-end close reduced from 15 days to 3, manual reporting work down roughly 60%, real-time KPI visibility, and cash visible weeks ahead. Not a promise of comparable outcomes.
- Location: Scottsdale, Arizona. Works with clients across the United States.
- Email: info@vantagerockfinancial.com
